name: event-sheet
description: A game the open file belongs to, as an event sheet: a map of its objects, rules, behaviors and components that opens each one's code, and a builder that paints a level and generates the game. The recognizer that reads the code runs in a worker of the extension's own.

paneViews.label: Event sheet
paneViews.title: The game's rules, objects and behaviors beside the code they're in
